$comment: Skin tones of the character's portrait, chosen when the character is made and later in Ustawienia. Every tone, Jasna too (the author: "567 A"), recolours the drawn skin from shadow to light on its ramp (tools/skin-tones.py, tools/evolution-tones.py, tools/walk-tones.py and tools/rider-tones.py make the files), so a look drawn in a darker skin still has a light Jasna; the drawn picture is only their source. swatch: the colour of the tone's dot on the screen.
